en.headline: Hong Kong fencing adds two team bronzes in foil and sabre
en.dek: The women’s foil and men’s sabre teams both lost their semi-finals on Saturday and collected bronze medals under the Asian Games format that awards third place without a play-off.
body: Hong Kong’s fencing team collected two more bronze medals at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Saturday after the women’s foil and men’s sabre squads both fell in the semi-finals.

In the women’s foil team semi-final, Janelle Leung, Valerie Cheng, Sophia Wu and Daphne Chan lost 27-45 to Japan. Leung trailed individual champion Yuka Ueno 3-5 in the opening bout; the side stayed close at 12-15 after three bouts before Japan pulled clear. Chan entered as substitute in the fifth bout but could not reverse the deficit.

In the men’s sabre team semi-final, Hugo Ho, Aaron Ho, Royce Chan and Leung Tin-ching lost 24-45 to South Korea. Hugo Ho trailed 2-5 in the first bout and the Korean side, anchored by individual champion Oh Sang-uk, controlled the match throughout.
With no third-place matches in team events, both Hong Kong squads received bronze. Further fencing medal chances remain on Sunday in the men’s épée team and women’s sabre team events.

zh.headline: 港隊劍擊女花男佩團體賽摘兩銅
zh.dek: 女子花劍及男子佩劍團體周六均於四強落敗，按亞運賽制無季軍賽直接獲銅牌。
body: 港隊劍擊周六再添兩面銅牌，女子花劍及男子佩劍團體均於四強落敗。
女花團體四強，梁雅蕾、鄭曉為、符妤名及陳諾思以27比45不敵日本。梁雅蕾首場對個人賽冠軍上野優佳以3比5落後，三場後港隊仍以12比15緊追，其後日本拉開差距，後備陳諾思第五場上場亦未能扭轉劣勢。
男佩團體四強，何瑋棋、何瑋樂、陳睿哲及梁天晴以24比45不敵南韓。何瑋棋首場以2比5落後，南韓由個人賽衛冕冠軍吳尚旭壓陣，全程領先。
團體賽不設銅牌戰，兩隊均獲銅牌。周日尚有男子重劍團體及女子佩劍團體賽事，仍有機會再添獎牌。
